summary: No-limit Texas Hold'em for a group of friends in the browser: pick a seat, buy in and play, with bots to fill the table. No npm dependencies, no image or sound files.
howItWorks: The server owns the game: one Table object holds every seat, the deck and the betting state, and each browser only sends actions (sit, bet, fold…).
After every change the server pushes each browser its own view over Server-Sent Events, so hole cards only ever reach the player holding them until showdown.

A browser is identified by a random id kept in localStorage, which is how one person can sit in several seats, and how a seat survives a closed tab. Each seat also gets a rejoin code for switching devices.
Every finished hand and chat message is written to SQLite, and the stats page is computed from those records.
The page re-renders on every update, so animations are keyed by when each card first appeared and resume where they were instead of restarting.

features.name: Texas Hold'em rules engine
features.what: Blinds, antes, min-raises, short all-ins that don't reopen betting, side pots, split pots with odd chips, and a 7-card hand evaluator. Tested with 2,000 random hands that must not create or lose a chip.

features.name: Move clock with a time bank
features.what: 10s per move plus a 60s bank that refills 5s a hand; running out checks or folds, and two timeouts in a row sits the player out.

features.name: Votes and votekicks
features.what: Seated players vote on settings changes and kicks; bots always vote yes, and a kick waits until the player's hand is over. A password overrides settings.

features.name: Test bots
features.what: A very basic bot that weighs hand strength against pot odds, used to fill seats and to fuzz-test the engine.

features.name: Stats and graphs
features.what: VPIP, PFR, aggression, showdown wins, bb/100 and decision speed per player, with net-chips, playing-style, pot-size and hand-type charts drawn as SVG with hover tooltips.

features.name: Synthesised sound packs
features.what: Card snaps, chip clinks, check knocks and win tunes generated from oscillators and filtered noise, in three styles.

features.name: Themes and custom backgrounds
features.what: Backgrounds, felts, card faces and backs chosen per player, plus uploaded background images shrunk in a canvas to fit in localStorage.

features.name: Hand history viewer
features.what: Every hand replayable with board, cards that were shown, chips in and out, and how long each move took, in a dialog or a pop-out window.
